description: For arbitrary original names \(X\), finite additional context \(\Gamma\) and arithmetic terms \(s,t,u,v\), the specified operation consumes a supplied actual HA certificate of \((s+t)\cdot u=v\) and constructs one of \(s\cdot u+t\cdot u=v\). It composes the reverse right-distributivity instance with that same input equality tree by transitivity, preserving \(X,\Gamma\).
